name: San Francisco Housing Authority
description: Housing vouchers and public housing for low-income San Francisco residents
fullDescription: The San Francisco Housing Authority administers public housing and Section 8 Housing Choice Vouchers for low-income San Francisco residents.
whatTheyOffer:
- Section 8 Housing Choice Vouchers
- Public housing units
- Project-based vouchers (PBV) and Rental Assistance Demonstration (RAD) housing
- Special programs (Emergency Housing Vouchers, VASH for veterans, Mainstream vouchers for people with disabilities, Family Unification, Foster Youth to Independence)
- Family Self-Sufficiency and Homeownership programs
howToGetIt:
1. Check the SFHA waitlist page for openings (as of September 2026, the HCV/Section 8, PBV, RAD, and Public Housing waitlists are all CLOSED)
2. Apply online when a waitlist opens (the last RAD/PBV and Public Housing opening was May 7-21, 2025, followed by a lottery)
3. Must meet income limits, citizenship/immigration status rules, and pass a background check
4. If placed on a waitlist, wait for your name to come up; check lottery status online
5. Questions: call (415) 715-5200 (Mon-Fri 8am-5pm) or email CustomerCare@sfha.org
keywords: SFHA, San Francisco Housing Authority, Section 8, public housing, housing voucher, low-income housing, SF, waitlist
